virtual.title: Create a virtual Vestaboard
virtual.description: A virtual Vestaboard behaves like a real one in Home Assistant, but has no hardware behind it. Use it to try out messages, or to try out an array before you buy more boards.

array.title: {action} a Vestaboard Note array
array.description: Combine Vestaboard Notes that are already set up, real or virtual, into one larger virtual board. Messages sent to the array are laid out across the whole grid, and each Note shows its portion.

init.description:
A Vestaboard that was part of **{array}** has been deleted, so **{array}** can no longer show messages.

Reconfigure **{array}** to choose a replacement or change its arrangement, or delete it.
